_comment: Shared O3 runtime configuration for every LiberiaEMR install.
Copying this file into the frontend image is not enough — it must also appear in
SPA_CONFIG_URLS (spa.configUrls) or O3 will ignore it. See IMPLEMENTATION.md §7.
Later layers (national -> programme -> site) are listed after this one in
SPA_CONFIG_URLS and therefore win on any key they redefine.
UUIDs here come from variables.properties as ${var.*} and are substituted at build
time — never paste a raw UUID into this file.
